scope: P7 general media input, version profile and engineering contract

media_input.staging: runs/media-staging/<uuid>/; 1-hour TTL; hash of staged bytes is what the native layer receives
media_input.files: any regular file inside a configured root, bounded by media_bytes

voice.normalisation: 8/16/24/32-bit, 1-2 channels, 8-48 kHz -> mono 16 kHz 16-bit, 20 ms frame padding

video.conversion: optional H.264/AAC MP4 via bundled ffmpeg when WECHAT_BOT_VIDEO_CONVERT=1

version_profile.note: Offsets are evidence per SHA256; they are never inferred from a version string.

engineering.config: environment + optional JSON (--config); unknown keys rejected; token, logs, caches and state under runs/
engineering.logging: rotating runs/bridge/bridge.jsonl, 10 MiB x 5; no message text or media bytes
engineering.http_contract: BRIDGE_SERVICE.md includes routes, states, error codes and examples

limitations: JPEG/GIF/WebP are converted before the native call, so the device-verified PNG path is preserved; the conversion itself is local-only evidence.
Video/MP3 conversion depends on the bundled ffmpeg and is optional; it has no real-device acceptance yet.
Media send limit defaults to 2 MiB; sizes above that are configurable but unverified on a phone.
High-resolution original image download remains outside P7 and is still not claimed.
